clips.title: The story
paras: Thundris Windweaver sends help from Auberdine to the ruins of Ameth'Aran. Restless Highborne spirits still carry enchanted relics through the shattered settlement, and he wants them taken away.

South of Auberdine and east of the coastal highway, Ameth'Aran's stone foundations lie overgrown. Ten thousand years ago, the settlement was a stronghold of the Highborne, the privileged aristocracy of the ancient night elven empire. Their unchecked use of arcane magic helped bring about the Sundering, which shattered Ameth'Aran. The inhabitants never truly left. Sentinels patrolling Darkshore report that the Highborne ghosts still haunt the sunken plazas, clutching the enchanted tools and trinkets they held in life.

For the kaldorei, arcane magic carries the memory of a danger that nearly destroyed life on Azeroth. Thundris Windweaver fears that leaving the Highborne implements in ghostly hands could invite corruption. He sends adventurers to wrest the relics from the restless spirits, intending to have them destroyed so their tainted magic cannot fuel another disaster.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Adventurer. A task I would ask of you.

Have you seen the ruins of Ameth'Aran? If not, you will find them on the eastern side of the main road, some ways to the south. Once they were the home of many powerful Highborne, now they are a testament to the destruction their dabblings produced.
I have been told by the Sentinels that the spirits of the Highborne persist, and that they wield their ancient magical implements. Those relics must be appropriated, so that we might destroy them.

clips.title: Progress
paras: If only the tools of their undoing could have been destroyed in the cataclysm that destroyed our world... Nonetheless, we must do what we can to ensure that the horrors of our past are not repeated in the future.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Though it is surely a figment of my imagination, I feel as though I can almost feel the taint of foul Highborne magic upon them. I will have these destroyed, so that their long dormant evil might never be released again.
